_comment: sim-couple-finedock-south-v1: MERGE into the mission runtime-config for the bounded GPU acceptance (start_at=couple, shelf_staging, --stop-after outbound) of the SOUTH-headed couple dock. dock_frame_approach is the one new key (added to the existing couple_cart_relative block) and is default-off => absent is byte-identical, so the EAST dock (coldwin22, no key) is unchanged. When true the couple nav DROPS the authored, world-frame couple_approach entirely and drives a SINGLE cart-relative standoff leg (standoff_from_cart on the MEASURED cart), then the fine-dock straight-reverse insert -- the whole couple is collinear on the cart's hitch axis for ANY dock yaw. The stale authored couple_approach was an EAST-dock world pose (yaw 0, x=-4.46) that, for the south seat (on-axis at ~(-3.875, 14.5, -pi/2)), dragged the base ~180 deg off-axis and silently stalled (towstaging1/2: parked, nav 'tracking' forever, 120 s no-base-progress). The couple then needs NO authored couple_approach/couple_standoff pose at all (they are ignored under dock_frame_approach; keep them only to run the legacy path). PASS = couple reaches a physical latch (coupled + healthy) within the stated sim time, then the straight coupled tow down the portal axis. CPU proof: scripts/check_couple_finedock_south.py; CPU tests: scripts/twin/tests/test_restock_runtime.py (test_couple_dock_frame_*) and test_restock_fine_dock.py (test_fine_dock_seats_the_recorded_south_dock, ..._east_dock_unchanged, ..._for_every_dock_heading). Diagnostic: a non-converging dock prints COUPLE_DOCK_FRAME (dock yaw, derived standoff, live hitch/cross/yaw residual) and fails by name on the capture or fine-dock band, never parks silently.
_fine_dock_note: The fine_dock block is unchanged from sim-robust-couple-approach-v1 (crosstrack + progress_cap); it carries NO comment key (FineDockConfig rejects unknown keys). The servo math is already dock-frame (every quantity is computed from the MEASURED cart yaw), so no per-heading tuning is needed -- the fix is the dock-frame APPROACH above, not the servo.
_acceptance_note: Merge ALSO the tow-lanes-mission-fragment.json (navigation.tow_lanes with the SOUTH couple_dock [-3.875, 15.77, -pi/2] and start [-3.875, 14.5, -pi/2]) and set start_at='couple', shelf_staging=true, stop_after='outbound'. With dock_frame_approach on, the authored mission_poses.couple_approach/couple_standoff are ignored by the couple nav, so a stale EAST pose there can no longer stall the south seat.
